rules.rule: Never delete git branches.
You may delete merged branches only after the user asks.
When adding a complete new level and adding new objects, create or modify the object code files game/objects/XX-name.c and .h.
When adding a new object, create `game/objects/XX-name/` with a JSON descriptor and C or ASM source.
Delete all map and player data as part of pre-test setup.
Never delete world save files such as server-world.dat, server-players.dat, or similar without explicit user permission.
Never force push the fork main branch to fix version state.
Force-push the reset main branch to origin for each fork.
Never silently rebase against a divergent remote.
For schema changes, run migrations after backing up.
If the tests pass, deploy to Railway.
Put code on its own branch.
When the memory system is not responding, check that `@claude-flow/memory` is installed by running `npm ls @claude-flow/memory`.
When adding a new tileset, add its PNG and JSON files to `game/tiles/`.
Keep a separate short-path clone of the repository for deployments.
When the memory system is not responding, check that the embedding model is cached under `~/.cache/huggingface/models/...`.
Do not start or restart the RDForward server process unless the user gives implicit or explicit permission.
Delete stale entries, or mark them obsolete if the lesson is now in a skill or feedback file.
When adding a new sound, add the WAV file to `game/sounds/` using `XX-name.wav` naming, where `XX` is the next number.
Do not create client-side stubs for rd-bridge-fabric.
You may adopt the references/ split pattern, scripts/ black-box helpers, evaluation QA pairs, and contribution guidelines from the awesome-agent-skills ecosystem.
Tell the user to run the written script with `powershell -File <path>`.
All objects should read `Gfx_BkgrndNewX` when calculating screen-relative positions.
Refer to `entire-cli.md` for the full Entire CLI reference.
Use different validation sets for the live machine and the CI runner.
Before ETL, detect Excel headers dynamically by scanning for key labels such as EMAIL and APELLIDO.
For 1.20.2 (v764), add explicit reverse entries for every S2C packet the server sends; do not rely on cascade to v762, which gives wrong IDs.
When parsing a Beta 1.8 handshake in `username;host:port` format, strip the `;host:port` suffix.
For schema changes, back up the database first.
If the level JSON InitData is empty, set DynospriteObject_InitSize to 0.
